notes.title: Controller Support Update Available !
notes.content:
Hello, everyone.

I'm proud to announce that you can now play SCHIZOPHRENIA with a Xbox controller,
from the main menu to the game ending.

It took a few days but it's now here !

I also fixed some small things.

Next update should be audio update or Steam achievements update.

I hope you'll like to play SCHIZOPHRENIA with a controller.

Note : PlayStation controller support is not planned for now.

Thank you for playing SCHIZOPHRENIA,
TheCourget.

Thank you for playing SCHIZOPHRENIA,

notes.title: Informations about SCHIZOPHRENIA.
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Firstly,
Thank you.
I've seen a lot of videos of SCHIZOPHRENIA on social medias like YouTube, and it's crazy.

Secondly,
I've seen people complaining about stereotypes.
Yes,
SCHIZOPHRENIA is based on stereotypes and it does not reflect reality.
I'm sorry for this misunderstanding, so, an update is coming in a few days, to add a section in the main menu, to provide documentation and redirect to sites that will fully explain schizophrenia.

Thirdly, the game will fix and add many things in a future update, as :

- Remaking the second flashback
- Fixing crosshair glitches
- Fixing softlocking with the kitchen trash
- Optimizing the game
- Fixing some more stuff

Thank you,
TheCourget

And remember, [url=https://honislabs.com/]Attman was WRONG[/url].
